items.title: Amber swatch
items.note: Warm yellow-brown. Reads darker on matte paper.

items.title: Cobalt swatch
items.note: Deep cool blue. Pairs with the amber swatch.

items.title: Ochre swatch
items.note: Earthy yellow. The most forgiving of the four.

items.title: Quartz point
items.note: Clear and six-sided, about the length of a thumb.

items.title: Banded agate slice
items.note: Polished on one face. Hold it to the light to see the bands.

items.title: Pyrite cube
items.note: Brassy and heavy for its size.

items.title: Obsidian flake
items.note: Glassy black with a sharp edge. Handle it by the sides.

items.title: Tracing vellum
items.note: Translucent. Ink sits on top and dries slowly.

items.title: Kraft card
items.note: Brown and stiff. Takes pencil well.

items.title: Newsprint pad
items.note: Cheap and thin, for quick sketches.
